provenance.ballPolicy: Moxie-specific separate ball follows the reverse gather, travels behind the far side and reaches her open far-side hand for frame5/tick12 release; never drawn into the poses.

review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct complete Moxie reverse-layup poses. Her identity, adult human anatomy, long lavender ponytail/gold tie, purple/silver kit and shoes remain consistent. She turns away during flight and releases with a high open far-side hand at frame5/tick12. No ball appears.
